headline: Failed House resolution would have expelled Representative George Santos from the House of Representatives.
what_it_does: This resolution would have removed Representative George Santos of New York from his seat in the House of Representatives. Expelling a member requires a two-thirds vote of the House. The House voted it down on November 1, 2023, so Santos kept his seat at that time.

who_it_affects.how: He would have lost his seat and his role as a member of the House.

who_it_affects.group: Residents of Santos's congressional district in New York
who_it_affects.how: They would have been left without a representative in the House until the seat was filled.
